title and abstract.summary: The study compared the taxonomic and functional diversity, as well as the prevalence of morphological and ecological traits, of ants and springtails across natural (indigenous forests and grasslands) and transformed (Eucalyptus plantations) biotopes in two environmentally contrasting regions of South Africa.

introduction.summary: The study assesses the influence of exotic plantations on the traits and functional diversity of soil arthropods, specifically focusing on ants and springtails, within a landscape mosaic.
